summary: XMax Inc. filed an 8-K to report a Cloud Services Agreement between its wholly owned subsidiary XMax AI Inc. and SuperX AI Technology USA. The agreement covers cloud computing, API access to AI models, and value-added services with total service fees of $4,800,000 payable monthly. XMax AI retains full ownership of its data. This is a routine commercial contract for cloud and AI services, not a special situation. The filing is a standard material definitive agreement disclosure without any change-of-control, capital structure, or strategic event elements.
